nodes.title: 🔌 LC Pipe

en.text:
One wire for model, VAE, prompts, sizes and sampler settings. Edit only what you wire.

**LC Pipe (in/edit)**
- Packs values into an LC_PIPE, or merges overrides into an existing pipe.

**LC Pipe Out**
- Expands an LC_PIPE into individual sockets and passes the pipe on. protect_mask (bottom): the areas the pipe detailers redrew.

**LC Pipe Combine**
- Edits the top pipe with a second pipe: whatever the edit pipe carries overwrites the top one, everything else rides along.

**LC Detail Pipe Out**
- Unpacks the detailer settings (models, prompts, seed, cfg, sampler, scheduler, steps) from an LC_PIPE. protect_mask (bottom): the areas the pipe detailers redrew.

nodes.title: 📐 Aspect Ratio Pipes

en.text:
The Aspect Ratio Simplifier with a pipe.

**📐 LC Aspect Ratio Simplifier (pipe)**
- Does the same as the Aspect Ratio Simplifier and adds a pipe output for Get/Set.

**LC Aspect Ratio Pipe (In/Edit)**
- Packs image, mask, size, latent, batch and resolution into an LC_PIPE, or edits one, overwriting only the wired sockets.

**LC Aspect Ratio Pipe Out**
- Unpacks the aspect ratio fields of an LC_PIPE into separate sockets and passes the pipe on.

nodes.title: 🖼️ Image Ref & MiniMax H3 Pipes

en.text:
Reference images and MiniMax H3 settings on one wire.

**LC Image Ref Pipe In 🖼️**
- Bundles up to 16 reference images into one pipe, with sockets that grow like Text Encode Qwen Image 2.1.

**LC Image Ref Pipe Out 🖼️**
- Unpacks an image ref pipe back into image_1 to image_16 in their original slots, pipe first.

**LC MiniMax H3 Pipe**
- Packs or edits an H3 pipe holding the prompts, references and settings for MiniMax H3.

**LC MiniMax H3 Pipe Out**
- Unpacks an LC MiniMax H3 pipe into its separate sockets.

**LC MiniMax H3 Pipe V2**
- Packs or edits an H3 pipe V2, which also carries prompt, steps, cfg, seed, sampler and scheduler.

**LC MiniMax H3 Pipe Out V2**
- Unpacks an H3 pipe V2, adding prompt, steps, cfg, seed, sampler and scheduler outputs.

nodes.title: 🗒️ Prompt Builder

en.text:
Build a prompt from parts, then put it together.

**🗒️LC Subject**
- Describes the subject of a prompt with freeform text plus pose, action, outfit and placement options.

**🗒️LC Subject Array**
- Combines several subject outputs into one line.

**🗒️LC Camera**
- Sets camera framing and depth of field for a prompt from distance and angle presets.

**🗒️LC Lighting**
- Sets lighting style and direction for a prompt from presets plus your own notes.

**🗒️LC Scene Builder**
- Builds a scene description from scene presets and objects.

**🗒️LC Style Selector**
- Picks a style preset (and quality level) for a prompt and adds your own notes.

**🎨LC Color Palette**
- Picks a 4 to 6 color palette from a preset or from an image, for use in prompts.

**🎲LC Wildcard**
- Picks a random line from a wildcard text file.

**🧩LC Prompt Assembler**
- Assembles the prompt builder pieces (subject, camera, lighting, style, scene) into one prompt or JSON.

nodes.title: 🗺️ Regional Canvas

en.text:
Paint regions on the node, one prompt per region.

**LC Anima Regional Inline Canvas**
- Paint RGB regions on the node and get a separate conditioning and mask for each region, for Anima regional prompting.

**LC Krea2 Regional Inline Canvas**
- Paint RGB regions on the node and get regional conditioning using the krea2 CLIP type.

nodes.title: About this workflow 👋

en.text:
# LC123 Examples - Pipes & Prompt Builders

Carry everything down one wire, and build prompts from parts.

- These are examples of every node in each section, with a short note on what it does. They are not wired: drop the ones you need into your own workflow.
- 💡 Hover any input for its tooltip. Full details in the [README](https://github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC123_nodes).

**In this workflow:**
- 🔌 LC Pipe
- 📐 Aspect Ratio Pipes
- 🖼️ Image Ref & MiniMax H3 Pipes
- 🗒️ Prompt Builder
- 🗺️ Regional Canvas
